No criminal proceedings, no insolvency, no sanctions-related litigation found. Per project rule 2 these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds.

note: Sanctions: no match found for 'Maini Materials Movement' on OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK or BIS Entity List — but this is a NEGATIVE-INDIRECT result only: the DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) throughout this session and Bing returned unrelated results, so no sanctions list was read directly. Treat sanctions_hit=null as 'not verified', not as 'confirmed clean'. Court cases: verified via Indian Kanoon (10 of 20 hits reviewed) — predominantly income-tax, central excise and service-tax appeals before ITAT Bangalore / CESTAT / Karnataka HC, plus one 2009 civil suit (Maini Materials Movement P Ltd vs Sri R Munikrishna) and one pending labour matter (Workmen of Maini Materials Movement Pvt Ltd vs Additional Labour Commissioner, Karnataka HC, listed 2026-08-03). No criminal cases, no insolvency/bankruptcy, no regulator penalty orders located. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action found in accessible sources; not public in what could be retrieved. Negative news: null — no adverse media located, but search coverage was severely degraded this session. RF/CIS supply: null — Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'Maini Materials Movement' + 'Russia' returned no matching results, and no export-to-Russia or CIS evidence was found; absence of evidence here is not proof of absence given the search outage. Company is an established Bengaluru material-handling equipment manufacturer (site: mainimaterials.com, claims operations since 1984); no risk-based rejection grounds identified under project rules.
